tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search open jobs on Frontrunner by what the person wants, in plain words: role, skills, place, remote or on-site, seniority, pay, company, how recent. Covers the US, Canada, India, Europe and remote roles, read from employers' own career pages. Returns up to 24 jobs a page with title, company, place

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Read one job on Frontrunner in full: the written description, skills, years of experience, salary when known, whether it is still open, common questions, and the links to view and apply. Pass the url (or slug) that search_jobs returned.
